content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm your education and work history qualify before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's training program.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all required sessions from your Jacksonville location or anywhere with internet access. Our instructors deliver real-world project-management scenarios and frameworks across five days of intensive, interactive online instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI will review your credentials and notify you when you're cleared to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides tailored to PMP domains. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll sit for the computer-based exam at an authorized testing center, demonstrating mastery of project-management knowledge and application.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) over each three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—training, volunteering, and self-directed learning—to accumulate PDUs and stay current in your field.
